name: GameWatch
author: TheD3v_
description: Per-game server status and patch note announcements for League of Legends, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, Counter-Strike 2, Escape from Tarkov, ARC Raiders, Arena Breakout: Infinite, and ROB RUN. Posts to dedicated per-game channels with optional role pings.
short: Game status and patch notes in per-game channels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users. It stores per-guild channel, role and region configuration only.
install_msg:
Thanks for installing GameWatch!

Set up per-game channels:
`[p]gamewatch news lol #lol-patch-notes`
`[p]gamewatch status lol #lol-status`
`[p]gamewatch games` lists every supported key.

LoL and TFT default to the EUNE region (`eun1`); change with `[p]gamewatch region <game> <region>`.
